recipe.visualDefinition: A low-angle, extreme close-up of a high-performance vehicle's tire and undercarriage in the foreground, framing a distant, blurred group of figures standing on a bright, hazy horizon. The aesthetic is gritty, high-contrast monochrome with a focus on mechanical textures.
coreVisualRelationships: Extreme foreground mechanical detail vs. distant soft-focus human subjects
Dark, heavy upper and side framing vs. bright, blown-out center horizon
Sharp tire tread texture vs. atmospheric haze in the background
coreInvariants: Low-angle perspective looking up from the ground
High-contrast black and white color palette
Framing device created by the car's wheel and chassis

compositionAndHierarchy.subjectPositionAndScale: A massive tire dominates the right third; the car body frames the top and left. The human subjects are small, centered, and positioned in the lower-middle distance.
compositionAndHierarchy.visualAnchor: The vertical line of the tire tread and the bright white horizon line.
compositionAndHierarchy.movementAndEyePath: Eye starts at the large foreground tire, moves left along the chassis, then drops down to the distant figures in the center.
compositionAndHierarchy.negativeSpace: The bright, hazy area between the car's undercarriage and the ground serves as a high-contrast focal point.

colorSystem.dominantColorRole: Deep black for shadows and mechanical structures.
colorSystem.contrastColorRole: Pure white for the sky/horizon and typography.
colorSystem.accentColorRole: Mid-tone grays for metallic reflections and tire textures.
colorSystem.saturationAndValueRelationship: Zero saturation; extreme value range from absolute black to blown-out white.

letterConstructionRules: Tight kerning with some overlapping strokes
characterSpecificRedesigns: The 'F' and 'S' characters feature elongated horizontal bars
Numerical characters are integrated with the same weight and slant as the letters
typographyAndGraphicLanguage.pairingStrategy: Uniform family pairing using different weights and scales of the same aggressive, slanted aesthetic.

candidateDirections.reason: Matches the technical, automotive, and wide-set feel.
Provides the necessary weight and square-off terminals.

twoStageComposition.backgroundInstruction: A low-angle, high-contrast black and white photo of a car's tire and underbody in the foreground. The tire is on the right, the chassis frames the top. In the distant center, a group of people are blurred silhouettes against a bright, hazy white sky. The ground is gravelly and textured.
twoStageComposition.overlayInstruction: Apply large, ultra-bold, extended italicized sans-serif text in solid white. Place the main title in the upper third, centered. Place a smaller, wide-tracked subtitle directly above it.

verificationChecks: Is the perspective extremely low to the ground?
Is the image strictly monochrome with high contrast?
Is the typography aggressively slanted and heavy?
Are the distant figures sufficiently blurred to maintain focus on the foreground textures?

adjustableVariables: Number of figures in the background
postGenerationChecks: Ensure the tire tread looks realistic and sharp.
Check that the white text is perfectly legible against the dark car body.
Verify the 'blown-out' effect of the background doesn't lose the ground plane.
Confirm the italic angle of all text is consistent.
recipe.reuseFormula: Low-angle mechanical framing + high-contrast monochrome + aggressive extended italic typography.
